title: Quietly Roasted Venezuelan Beef Skewers
description: A traditional Venezuelan dish featuring bitter and chewy beef skewers, perfect for a solo dinner, with the added benefit of being ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together thyme, garlic, black pepper, salt, and paprika.
Add the beef strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the beef strips onto the wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a wooden board lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the rendered fat over the beef skewers.
Roast the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
